title: Observe European descriptor bank zero in Item information
changes: Identify the original Item information path to bank zero and document its ordinary typed reads.
validation: One bounded 800-frame Wine observation served pointer, field 0, field 2, kind and byte 7; 219 protected files and 703 frozen sources remained unchanged.
limitations: Field 4 and a full raw versus managed comparison remain unverified; Linux, USA and native Windows are pending. No performance measurements.
